evidence_quote: proposes a single Building Energy Performance assessment model that considered several factors that affect office-building energy efficiency performances
the survey is limited to contemporary variables and not historical phenomenon (actual energy used data)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a structural-equation / factor-analysis tool (EFA + CFA/SEM on occupant Likert-survey data) identifying organisational critical success factors (management, strategic, operational) that affect office/educational building energy performance. It explicitly excludes actual energy-use data and constructs no EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model or baseline; EnPI/EnB concepts (BEU, BEU-intensity) appear only incidentally. Building sector, no industrial component -> tool/framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The findings present a procedure for analysis of the contemporary issues that affect building energy efficiency, which serves as a tool for performing BEP assessment

stage1.notes: paper_type borderline: coded tool/software design (self-described 'procedural tool'/'protocol' yielding a BEP assessment tool); could also read as methodological/theoretical or multi-case (10 pooled case buildings, Nigeria+UK). ISO 50001 appears only in cited references, not applied; no continuous-process/refinery context.
